title: Tunisian Weeknight Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap using pandan leaves, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Featuring Chinese sesame sauce and satvik-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Mix rice flour, water, yeast, and salt in a bowl to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk using a rolling pin.
Place a pandan leaf on a flat surface and place a disk on it.
Brush the edges of the disk with water and fold the leaf over the disk to form a wrap.
Heat the sesame sauce in a small pan over low heat.
Add grated ginger and green chilies to the sesame sauce and stir well.
Place a wrap in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until it becomes golden brown.
Flip the wrap over and cook for another 2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining dough and sesame sauce.
Serve the wraps hot with chopped cilantro sprinkled on top.
